<SW.Blocks.CompileUnit ID="1" CompositionName="CompileUnits">
  <AttributeList>
    <NetworkSource><FlgNet xmlns="http://www.siemens.com/automation/Openness/SW/NetworkSource/FlgNet/v4">
      <Parts>
        <!-- 分支1：串联常开+常闭→线圈(风机运行) -->
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="101"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机运行按" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="102"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机故障反馈" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="103"><Symbol><Component Name="风机运行" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Part Name="Contact" UId="110" />
        <Part Name="Contact" UId="111"><Negated Name="operand" /></Part>
        <Part Name="Coil" UId="112" />
        <!-- 分支2：常闭→MOVE(自动输出→控制输出) -->
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="201"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机手动" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="202"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机自动输出" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="203"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机控制输出" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Part Name="Contact" UId="210"><Negated Name="operand" /></Part>
        <Part Name="Move" UId="211"><TemplateValue Name="Card" Type="Cardinality">1</TemplateValue></Part>
        <!-- 分支3：常开→MUL(手动频率×2.0→控制输出) -->
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="301"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机手动" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="302"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机手动频率" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="LiteralConstant" UId="303"><Constant><ConstantType>Real</ConstantType><ConstantValue>2.0</ConstantValue></Constant></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="304"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机控制输出" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Part Name="Contact" UId="310" />
        <Part Name="Mul" UId="311"><TemplateValue Name="Card" Type="Cardinality">2</TemplateValue><AutomaticTyped Name="SrcType" /></Part>
      </Parts>
      <Wires>
        <!-- 分支1 Wire -->
        <Wire UId="120"><Powerrail /><NameCon UId="110" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="121"><IdentCon UId="101" /><NameCon UId="110" Name="operand" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="122"><NameCon UId="110" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="111" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="123"><IdentCon UId="102" /><NameCon UId="111" Name="operand" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="124"><NameCon UId="111" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="112" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="125"><IdentCon UId="103" /><NameCon UId="112" Name="operand" /></Wire>
        <!-- 分支2 Wire -->
        <Wire UId="220"><Powerrail /><NameCon UId="210" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="221"><IdentCon UId="201" /><NameCon UId="210" Name="operand" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="222"><NameCon UId="210" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="211" Name="en" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="223"><IdentCon UId="202" /><NameCon UId="211" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="224"><NameCon UId="211" Name="out1" /><IdentCon UId="203" /></Wire>
        <!-- 分支3 Wire -->
        <Wire UId="320"><Powerrail /><NameCon UId="310" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="321"><IdentCon UId="301" /><NameCon UId="310" Name="operand" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="322"><NameCon UId="310" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="311" Name="en" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="323"><IdentCon UId="302" /><NameCon UId="311" Name="in1" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="324"><IdentCon UId="303" /><NameCon UId="311" Name="in2" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="325"><NameCon UId="311" Name="out" /><IdentCon UId="304" /></Wire>
      </Wires>
    </FlgNet></NetworkSource>
    <ProgrammingLanguage>LAD</ProgrammingLanguage>
  </AttributeList>
  <ObjectList>
    <MultilingualText ID="4" CompositionName="Comment"><ObjectList><MultilingualTextItem ID="5" CompositionName="Items"><AttributeList><Culture>zh-CN</Culture><Text>风机运行控制和自动/手动模式选择输出</Text></AttributeList></MultilingualTextItem></ObjectList></MultilingualText>
    <MultilingualText ID="6" CompositionName="Title"><ObjectList><MultilingualTextItem ID="7" CompositionName="Items"><AttributeList><Culture>zh-CN</Culture><Text>风机输出</Text></AttributeList></MultilingualTextItem></ObjectList></MultilingualText>
  </ObjectList>
</SW.Blocks.CompileUnit>
